The first night of Winter. A day ends at the fire; a season ends there too, only longer. The village sits up late.
Behind us: Autumn. Harvest season. Nuts, persimmons, last greens. Fatten up. The Codex grew this season — 49 new: Ghost Pipe, Jewelweed, Dandelion (+46 more).
The season took Meera, Salvador, Simone. Their names are spoken, then the fire is quiet a while.
Winter is coming. Around the fire, the gaps show: nobody here knows Debris Shelter and Fire in Rain — and the season will ask.

🔥 The fire settles. Paola has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Moderator — I put it down today." "It reviews you. 'Content noted.' A weak ranging chip while it decides." "'REMOVAL NOTICE.' Defiant or compliant — the hammer is coming down." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Cecilia says quietly "So it bleeds." Daniyar says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
